Definition: of Chaldee origin; date-house; Beth-any, a place in Palestine:--Bethany.
BiblicalUsage: The name Bethany appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Matthew 21:17, Matthew 26:6 and Mark 11:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bethany is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
